name: mastra-contextual-governance
//: zod is pinned to one exact 4.x version, repo-wide, by the override below. The old 3.x pin (#28) guarded an Arcade TypeScript SDK this repo never depended on, and by #187 it blocked @mastra/mcp 2, whose MCP SDK requires zod ^4.2. One version everywhere is the point: two zods in one process disagree about instanceof.

apps/idp is a workspace member since #187: with the override at zod 4, Better Auth installs from the root like everything else, so a fresh clone needs one `bun install` and there is one lockfile. It is still the enterprise IdP stand-in a forker deletes, so it depends on nothing in the template and nothing depends on it — apps/idp/test/knows-people-not-loans.test.ts enforces both halves.

dev:idp-stub keeps `--cwd apps/loan-app` because that is where the stub lives, but it binds IDP_PUBLIC_HOST's port, not the PORT in that directory's .env.local — which is the loan API's. See #56 and the comment at the top of apps/loan-app/scripts/dev-idp.ts; apps/loan-app/test/dev-idp-port.test.ts fails if it goes back to PORT.
